metrics.label: Sediment export
metrics.scope_label: Modeled overland sediment delivery to streams

units.display_policy: Keep each substance in its physical units through deltas, export, and charts.
units.rate_to_mass_scope: Native model layer already performs this conversion; the decision consumer reads sum_units and does not multiply native totals by pixel area.

percent.zero_label: Baseline is zero; compare the absolute change.

scope.benefit_aggregation: Use the selected receiving/reporting extent so changes propagated outside the intervention footprint contribute to the result.
scope.cumulative_catchments: When selected catchments overlap or nest, aggregate their union or report them separately; summing their totals repeats shared upstream contributions.
scope.climate_comparison: An explicit climate counterfactual keeps both source periods visible alongside the annual averaging definition.

tradeoffs.pareto_rule: Candidate A dominates B when A is at least as good on every selected benefit metric and strictly better on at least one, on the same comparison support.

composite.weight_normalization: Divide each nonnegative weight by the sum of weights.
composite.reference_scope: Each saved assessment retains the selected baseline, common alternative identities, and minimum and maximum for every weighted metric and geography.
composite.changing_candidate_cohort: Changing selected alternatives recomputes the common cohort and its ranges. Saving creates a new immutable assessment revision.
composite.constant_metric: A criterion with equal values across its common cohort contributes no distinction; its constant flag and range remain in the assessment.
composite.missing_selected_metric: Show its available physical metrics; omit an incomplete candidate from the common composite and Pareto comparison cohort.

tradeoffs.presentation: Show the physical values and tradeoffs alongside a composite score.

ensembles.pairing: Join baseline and scenario by the same uncertainty draw and shared source edition.
ensembles.aggregate: Calculate each paired difference first, then summarize those differences.
ensembles.case_share_label: Share of completed cases showing benefit
ensembles.zero_valid_pairs: Show the completed individual results and the missing pair identities.
ensembles.portfolio_interactions: Use the completed combined-intervention run for a portfolio; separately modeled parcel benefits can interact through downstream retention.

community_context.population_label: Population of listed census block groups
community_context.geographic_interpretation: Whole block-group estimates provide community context. Service-area population or population inside a partial catchment requires its own geographic allocation.
community_context.median_income_rule: Retain the published median for each block group; medians do not add or average into a valid combined median.

explanations.title: Two useful priorities
explanations.text: Present export identifies existing pressure. The change caused by a stated development scenario identifies land whose protection could avoid increased export.

explanations.title: Nutrient export
explanations.text: NDR represents average annual nutrient delivery to streams. Its flow paths connect upstream sources with downstream vegetation. Nitrogen may include surface and subsurface components. Compare scenarios over the same receiving area.

explanations.title: Where protection has value
explanations.text: A pixel's nutrient load minus export describes retention along its downstream path. Scenario differences describe the change reaching streams when land cover or management changes.

explanations.title: Sediment export
explanations.text: SDR describes annual overland erosion delivered to streams. Local erosion, downstream trapping, and exported sediment are distinct quantities. Streambank and channel processes belong in the broader observed sediment budget.

explanations.title: Community context
explanations.text: The Appendix F table contains 17 block groups associated with two utilities and four focus watersheds. Its listed population is 27,448.

explanations.title: Comparable geography
explanations.text: A comparison uses one reporting extent and matching valid coverage. Upstream routing remains intact while the displayed totals describe the selected area.

explanations.title: Tradeoffs and preferences
explanations.text: The Pareto view shows choices that improve different outcomes. The optional combined score uses explicit weights and min/max ranges from the selected common cohort. Saved assessments retain the cohort and each range.

explanations.title: Source-water priorities
explanations.text: The protection maps combine named resources, their connected land, and modeled pollutant transfer. Sediment, nitrogen, and phosphorus describe pathways relevant to the source-water assessment.

rfp.title: Upstate Forever GIS mapping and modeling opportunity

objectives.label: Minimize annual export
objectives.description: Compare the annual export of completed alternatives over the selected area. Smaller values indicate lower modeled export.

objectives.label: Find restoration and management gains
objectives.description: Compare current conditions with the stated restoration or management alternative. Larger positive reductions indicate greater modeled benefit.

objectives.label: Prioritize land protection
objectives.description: Compare intact current conditions with a stated development counterfactual. Larger positive increases identify greater modeled protection value from avoiding that conversion.

objectives.label: Choose a lower-impact development pattern
objectives.description: Compare proposed development alternatives against the same current baseline. Smaller increases indicate a lower modeled export impact.

implementation.comparison_basis: Original annual mass; shared-baseline objective directions are mapped explicitly to raw-mass directions.
implementation.future_fixed_reference_method: A separate fixed-reference scorer can be selected after its actual implementation is connected; this component uses saved common-cohort ranges.
